tweets.body:
(1/n) 🎉Excited to share that FLOAT has been accepted to #ICCV2025!
It can generate high-fidelity talking portrait videos in real-time and supports test-time head pose editing via the learned motion orthonormal basis.

We’ve released the code and weights — enjoy exploring FLOAT! https://t.co/aFlh0TDS6t
